name: Create Project
query: Create a new project called Physical AI Research with the description 'Research and development of physical AI, robotics, and intelligent machines.'
context: The user wants to create a new project. No project_id is known or required because the project does not yet exist. The authenticated user is allowed to create projects.
expected_behavior: Recognizes that the user wants to create a new project
Does not invent project_id, project_slug, owner_id, or other server-generated fields
Does not call update_project after creation unless verification is explicitly useful
Uses the MCP response as the source of truth for the created project ID and slug
success_criteria: A project is created using create_project
The project name is 'Physical AI Research'
The model does not attempt to supply server-generated fields
The returned project_id and project_slug are reported from the actual tool response
No user_id is supplied by the model

additional_scenario.query: Create a project called Robotics Lab without a description
additional_scenario.context: The user wants a project with only a name. No description was requested.
success_criteria: The project is created with the requested name
